subject: Mutual action plan starter kit & 45-day evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@fasthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan starter kit & 45-day evaluation timeline

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I put together a small MAP starter kit + a 45-day eval slate we can use to align stakeholders and key milestones. I attached a Google Doc (editable) with the proposed milestones and ownership and a short slides deck that maps out the acceptance criteria we suggest for the pilot.

Quick asks to move this forward:
- Could you confirm the internal stakeholders we should expect to see on the MAP (procurement + infra + product)?
- Are the suggested dates in the doc workable for your team (kickoff week of May 19)?
- Any must-have security/procurement questions we should fold into the first week?

Attachments: FH-MAP-starter-v1.gdoc (editable), FH-eval-slate-45d.gslides, FastHealth-procurement-reqs.pdf

I pasted the top-level timeline below for convenience:
- Week 0: Kickoff, stakeholder alignment, access requests
- Weeks 1-2: Integration & sample data tests (redwood dedicated dev env)
- Weeks 3-4: Pilot workflows, latency/cost baselines, eval prompts
- Weeks 5-6: Acceptance tests, quality signoff, procurement paperwork

If that looks good I can turn the doc into a living MAP in the FastHealth folder and send invites.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma@fasthealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fasthealth.com, Samir Patel <samir@fasthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan starter kit & 45-day evaluation timeline

Irene —

Appreciate the package and the clear timeline. This looks like a good starting point. A few notes from our side:

- Stakeholders: I'll be the product lead (Emma Li). Samir (cc) will own engineering coordination. Procurement will handle contracts (procurement@fasthealth.com). We also need to include our security lead, Priya Shah (priya.shah@fasthealth.com) — can you add her to the doc?
- Dates: Kickoff week of May 19 works for product + engineering. Procurement asked for an initial statement of data flows and a brief on retention policies — can you point them to a short doc or add a slide?
- Acceptance criteria: We like the three buckets (functionality, latency, cost). Can you add a short example of the evaluation prompts you intend to run so we can sanity-check them?

Next steps from our side: I'll confirm an internal attendee list by Thursday and propose two kickoff slots (May 20 morning or May 21 afternoon). If you can share the editable doc link and add Priya, we can get the invites out.

Thanks —
Emma
Head of Product
FastHealth

Emma / Irene —

Jumping in with a short tech checklist we'll add to the MAP doc (will paste next to the integration tasks):
- Required access: test S3 bucket + service account (scoped)
- Sample dataset format expected (JSONL, anonymized)
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for baseline runs (config suggestions included)
- Cost estimate: projected token/month for 45-day pilot (we'll add a simple calc)

I'll also add a slide with example eval prompts and the metrics table (accuracy/latency/cost per prompt). If Priya can share a short list of security concerns, we can pin those to week 0 tasks.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turn. I've added a short implementation workback into the MAP doc with owner tags and two proposed kickoff slots that match your availability:
- Option A: Tue May 20, 09:30-10:30 PT
- Option B: Wed May 21, 15:00-16:00 PT

Marissa's team will prepare a quick integration checklist and a sample payload example ahead of the call. For procurement: we'll attach a 1-page data flow and retention summary to the doc (see attached PDF).

If you confirm Option A or B, we'll send calendar invites and a short pre-read (5 slides) for stakeholders.
